southeast.title: B.C. man reunited with beloved flute, 5 years after it floated away down a Yukon river
southeast.description: Jun Takahashi was stunned when he saw the online post: someone in the Yukon bush had found a canoe barrel full of his mildew-y camping gear, and his long-lost flute.

all.title: How a loophole in Canada's species-at-risk law can leave wildlife in limbo
all.description: A new study finds a legal gap in Canada's Species at Risk Act can leave species waiting years for protection, with 153 of 288 cases overdue and still unresolved as of January 2025.
